proposals: The Lok Sabha Secretariat should make the full text of answers searchable on sansad.in, not only the subject line, so a question whose subject names no scheme but whose answer discusses one at length can still be found.

The Lok Sabha Secretariat should publish a bulk, machine-readable download of every question and answer — number, date, ministry, member, subject, starred or unstarred, and answer text — for the 17th and 18th Lok Sabha, so registries like this one need not be built by keyword harvesting.

The Lok Sabha Secretariat should tag each question with the government schemes it concerns, using a scheme list supplied by ministries, so classification no longer depends on outside regex maps that must guard against false matches such as “Sanchar Mitra” filing under PM MITRA.
